title: Session Resilience + Durable Recovery Stack

source_provenance.locator: 2026-08-21 instruction to solve abrupt page/session loss for future, integrate into engines/self-improvement, add engineering modules/contracts/proofs/protocols
2026-08-21 abrupt ChatGPT logout/page-loss during active IVDIVO work

source_provenance.notes: 18C checkpoint tool/schema/tests and Run32 evidence merged
Existing registry transaction authority reused; no parallel registry writer

problem_or_opportunity: A durable checkpoint can prove where work stopped, but safe recovery also requires multi-store write reconciliation, idempotency, checkpoint lineage/retention, and measured interruption evidence. Run32 additionally exposed that a candidate ID selected from partial visibility can collide with the full registry family.
proposed_mechanism: Extend 18C with a project-neutral durable transaction reconciler, explicit external-side-effect states, checkpoint lineage/retention ledger, interruption-learning evidence summarizer, and full registry-family ID freshness before candidate registration. Fail-closed order remains blocker -> authority/state drift -> identity/effect reconciliation -> safe missing actions -> exact completion.
expected_benefit: Prevents duplicate GitHub/Drive/provider work after interruption, quarantines ambiguous paid/irreversible side effects, preserves checkpoint lineage without transcript bloat, and gives Self-Improvement measurable recovery evidence instead of anecdotal claims.

protected_invariants: No automatic replay of paid or irreversible effects
acceptance_conditions: Full registry family has unique candidate IDs
At least one real interruption recovery before promotion beyond pilot
development_contract.rollback: Remove SI-0014 Run33 modules/protocol references and retain merged 18C; do not roll back unrelated registry transaction, project-state, audio or story authorities.

pilot_evidence: PR #100 merged after 10/10 focused checkpoint regression and Self-Improvement Integrity CI
Run32 handled two real concurrent-main advances via REBASE_FIRST without overwriting sibling work
Run33 prototype: 22/22 deterministic tests PASS for durable transaction, checkpoint lineage/retention, and interruption-learning evidence
Run33 full-registry freshness sweep detected and corrected the erroneous pending SI-0010 identity before further promotion
red_team_findings: Partial candidate-ID visibility is insufficient; always inspect full registry family before assigning IDs
Provider accepted != production asset accepted != canonical/voice/take lock
STARTED_UNKNOWN paid/irreversible action must quarantine rather than retry
Identity mismatch after confirmed write is STOP, not repair-in-place
Retention must preserve incident evidence but garbage-collect superseded routine checkpoints
next_action: Complete Run33 integration/CI/Drive readback, then use the next genuine interruption/partial multi-store event as production pilot evidence.
hold_trigger: Any false resume, secret leak, duplicate paid/irreversible side effect, registry ID collision, or checkpoint/transaction overhead that materially harms production.
